issues.explanation: Numeric-string priorities like "10" are accepted as valid, while the contract and docs require an integer priority.
queueAppearance reads $preset->appearance['queues'] when appearance is nullable, risking an array-offset-on-null warning instead of null-coalescing.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/* for writes reusing IssueTicket (TotemQueueController.php:431); TotemPreset.php:656 $fillable excludes login_code*; reversible migrations with down(); Log::channel('audit'); docs/api/totem.md, database-schema.md, architecture.md, CHANGELOG.md, .env.example updated

readability.evidence: small focused methods authorizeEntity/forbidden/resolveQueue/entityPayload/queueAppearance (TotemQueueController.php:473-504); clear names and PHPDoc; consistent style; only nit is nullable appearance offset

requirements.evidence: routes/api.php:1-14 totem/auth + 3 endpoints; PairTotem.php:118-171 transaction with lockForUpdate, single-use consumption, totem creation, JWT claims totem_id/entity_id/preset_id/queues/iat/exp/jti; TotemQueueController.php:369-443 queues/priorities/ticket with 400/401/403/404/422 codes; config/cors.php:898-900 localhost patterns; docs updated from proposal to implemented

scope.evidence: all hunks serve the totem BFF (models, migrations, routes, middleware, actions, JWT, config, docs, tests); no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: AuthenticateTotem.php:534-566 strict claim type checks, totem/preset active and entity match, 401 invalid_token, quiet last_seen_at update with scope intersection; TotemJwt.php:785-797 HS256-only, hash_equals, mandatory exp; TotemAuthController.php:311-323 format 400 vs no-oracle 401 and never logs code

simplicity.evidence: minimal HS256 TotemJwt.php:756 instead of new dependency; PairTotem reuses entityQueueIds(); ticket reuses App\Actions\IssueTicket with TicketChannel::Totem; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TotemAuthTest.php, TotemEndpointsTest.php, TotemCorsTest.php, TotemJwtTest.php, TotemModelsTest.php, TotemPairingTest.php cover pairing, JWT round-trip/tamper/alg/exp/secret, 400/401 no-oracle, 403/404/422 scope, 10/min and 30/min throttles, audit without code, last_seen_at, cascade and uniqueness

review.summary: Implements the full totem BFF (pairing command, JWT auth, three scoped endpoints, CORS, docs and migrations) reusing IssueTicket with thorough Pest coverage. Only two nits remain (lenient string priorities, nullable appearance access), so approve with nits.
